# Get all liked songs (paginate)
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_songs)}")
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print(liked_ids)

steps.code:
# Keep going to previous song until we reach a liked song
current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print(f"Current song: {current_song['song_id']} - {current_song['title']}")

# Loop until we find a liked song
max_attempts = len(apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token))  # queue size
for i in range(max_attempts + 1):
    if current_song['song_id'] in liked_ids:
        print(f"Found liked song: {current_song['song_id']} - {current_song['title']}")
        break
    # Go to previous song
    prev_result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Previous song result: {prev_result}")
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Now current: {current_song['song_id']} - {current_song['title']}")
else:
    print("No liked song found in queue")
